$comment: Golden cases of the messenger (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py; P16 spec 5.7.7, 12): the friend group open with 13 members (5 online, the online first), the guild group with 4, an online friend selected (whisper and remove on); foundation: the family group with the lover (love 87), 64 friends with 22-character names cut by the list (the scroll), the remove button alone on; empty: both groups showing the empty line; closed-groups: both groups closed at legacy's least height (150); translucent: modern-dark and modern-light at 80% panel opacity over the synthetic backdrop. The rosters' Helper and Team members show their language flags (assets/locale), the Blocked Players group its blocked player (NOVA-30/46/47); the block and unblock buttons sit above the icons; rosters: Friend and Guild closed, Helper and Team with their members' flags, the Blocked Players' one selected (Unblock on). Its classic art is in assets/ETC. The modern frames leave about 140dp right of the window and 130dp below it, so its shadow stays inside them; classic keeps its own frames.
